description: Imperial / foreign stone-timber fringe — farmhouse shells, the Solitude dock family and keeled small craft. The foreign layer of the province: west/north-west fringe, Topal ports and road corridors only. Second sourcing pass adds the two Cyrodiilic flat-bottomed ferries and rowboat from Ships and Boats of Tamriel — the foreign river traffic of the Topal ports. TROPICALISED: `textureOverlayPools: ["tropical"]` puts Tropical Skyrim's retextures (vanilla filenames, architecture-TEXTURE-only — it ships no architecture meshes) ahead of the vanilla texture fallback, so the vanilla-backed pieces read hot and wet instead of Nordic grey. A pool's own textures still win, so the sourced-mod pieces keep their authored look. Drop the key to rebuild the un-overlaid variant.
